checks.name: County RP taxable TY2026: ORION vs DOR certified (real property)
checks.detail: Unresolved. ORION market value is $34.59B vs certified $32.06B, so the gap is in taxable value, not in missing parcels. Billings reconciles within 0.2% (V3), so the shortfall sits outside the cities. A likely cause is industrial property (the three refineries) that DOR certifies at values or class rates not carried in the county ORION extract. All mapped taxes still come from ORION/Treasurer values; the county-wide value of a mill in the calculator is understated by about 12%.
